title: HerdCraft Terraprism
description: Replaces diamond sword with a terraprism from Terraria in 26w14a HerdCraft April fools update
body:
# Terraprism in Herdcraft This resourcepack replaces a diamond sword with a terraprism from Terraria
### Terraprisms attacking golem ![Terraprisms attacking golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28189eabe412d14c23ba17e1c872ed3c6935c4b6.jpeg)
### Terraprism craft ![Terraprism craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f28bc20417916eed45a9a28e2182b7cee13bad1.jpeg)
### Terraprism, if you equip it on head (Done with a command: `/item replace entity @s armor.head with minecraft:diamond_sword`) ![Terraprism, if you equip it on head](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cb58a871ac3ec73d3d604dedeb550f973c9ecf2.jpeg)


_**By downloading this resourcepack, you agree that Empress Of Light is the hottest boss in Terraria**_
